claims.claim: We offer all our clients 5 star☆ service (never buy an item because it's cheap...)
claims.evidence: No photo can confirm service quality or seller reliability claims; this is a marketing statement, not a product fact.

risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of part number/OEM code stamped on housing, or seller confirmation of donor vehicle with matching engine bay photo
risks.if_unproven: price as generic/unconfirmed-fit used part, lowest tier for that part type

risks.risk: Functional status of sensors/wiring not tested
risks.proof: Video clip showing connector plugged into a tester or multimeter continuity check

risks.risk: Assembly may be incomplete (missing clips, bolts, sub-sensors)
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles showing all mounting points and included hardware laid out
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete assembly, deduct for missing standard components

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or internal damage not visible from single angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos/video of all sides including underside and intake opening
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetic-unknown, assume worst-case hairline damage

risks.risk: Wiring harness connector pins could be corroded or broken
risks.proof: Close-up photo of connector pins and a video of it clicking into a mating connector
risks.if_unproven: price as connector condition unknown, risk of replacement needed

proof_requests: Clear photo of any stamped part number or OEM code on the housing
Photo/video confirming which vehicle make, model, and engine size this was removed from
Video showing the electrical connector being tested or plugged in
Additional angle photos showing underside, intake opening, and all mounting tabs
Close-up of the connector pins for corrosion/damage check
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type (used air intake/filter housing assembly with harness), so it can be priced at worst case given unverified compatibility, function, and completeness; the seller's words add no verifiable product facts.
